verdict_reason: The row projections and server-side storage of shown search rows are sound, but the stored key name is duplicated as a literal in flow.js.

todos.issue: The flow-only answer key 'commoditySearchRows' is written twice in this PR: rows.js:4 exports it as SHOWN_SEARCH_ROWS, and flow/flow.js:23 repeats the literal in FLOW_ONLY_KEYS. Renaming one leaves the rows stored under a key the flow no longer treats as flow-only (sent to the backend) or never cleared.
todos.fix: Must: the 'commoditySearchRows' key is written once, and FLOW_ONLY_KEYS refers to that owner. One way: import SHOWN_SEARCH_ROWS into flow/flow.js and use it in FLOW_ONLY_KEYS.
